notes.title: Version 0.4.12a Live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just added some quality settings to the options menu, which are now also accessible in-game, to enhance performance on mid-range and low-end computers.

Changelog for version 0.4.12a:

You can now adjust the depth of field quality.
You can now modify fog quality.
In-game options menu is now available.
minor bug fixing

Note: this update is also available for the demo.

Stay tuned for more updates. 

You'll never want to leave the maze.

The Daedalus Team.

notes.title: Version 0.4.8a live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
We have just released a new version with some important changes. 
Here's the log:

Networking code improved (lag removed).
The player no longer slides while moving around.
Female character added.
New puzzle added.
Option menu added (not in-game yet).
Lighting enhanced.
The ragdoll improved upon player death.
The difficulty of some puzzles has been balanced.
Music and sound effects improved.

    
The major improvement involves the netcode for sure: some players had a hard time trying to move across the labyrinth due to network lag, so we took some time to figure out how to fix this issue... and we did it: player movement is now much smoother and responsive.

We are exited to announce our partecipation in the Steam Scream Festival, and we are working on adding a brand-new feature to the gameplay.

Stay tuned,
the Daedalus team.
